events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 enter March eleven points ahead at the top of the FA Premier League , with their nearest contenders 아스널 having 3 games in hand.
반즐리's dreams of marking their first top division season with FA Cup glory are ended when they lost 3–1 at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the quarter-final.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign Greek defender Nikos Dabizas from 올림피아코스 for £2million.
A solitary Marc Overmars goal sees 아스널 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 at Old Trafford to decrease United's lead to 6 points, plus they have the advantage of 3 games in hand.

노츠 카운티 , Division Three leaders, become the first English team to win promotion in March. In the Premier League, 맨체스터 유나이티드 bounce back from their 아스널 disappointment with a 2–0 home win over 윔블던, while 아스널 keep the pressure intense with a 1–0 win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 리버풀 keep their slim title hopes alive with a 3–2 win over a 반즐리 side battling against relegation.

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the league by a six-point margin as March ends, but their nearest contenders 아스널 have three games in hand. 리버풀 in third place are nine points off the top with a game in hand, and meet United at Old Trafford in 10 days for what could be a decisive game in the title race. 첼시 occupy fourth place and if they finish in the top five then a sixth placed team will automatically qualify for the UEFA Cup for the first time as 첼시 have won the League Cup and new rules regarding European competitions mean that lower-placed teams can qualify for Europe. An unlikely bid for a UEFA Cup place is coming from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 코번트리 시티, two means who narrowly avoided relegation last season. Meanwhile, 반즐리, 볼턴 원더러스 and 크리스털 팰리스 continue to occupy the relegation zone. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top of Division One, two points ahead of second placed 미들즈브러 and four points ahead of third placed 선덜랜드. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 셰필드 유나이티드 and a resurgent 입스위치 타운 complete the top six.
